name: Fruit (buffed)
author: dashiell10
description: Go between the hitboxes of the structure at 40.98% as the mini wave. Drop onto the structure at 41.6%. Spam above the saw at 42% and drop onto the platform at 42.7%. Move down at 45%, touch the dash orb and then spam in between the invisible moving platforms until 46.4% where you can move to the ceiling. Go in the middle of the level from 47.1%-47.9% to avoid a saw on the ceiling and then hold back to the ceiling. Move to the floor shortly after passing the dash orb at 50% and stay there. Stay on the floor until the end from there.
